arxiv-2202-01839.title: From quantum speed limits to energy-efficient quantum gates
arxiv-2202-01839.creator: Maxwell Aifer, Sebastian Deffner
arxiv-2202-01839.description: Abstract While recent breakthroughs in quantum computing promise the nascence of the quantum information age, quantum states remain delicate to control. Moreover, the required energy budget for large scale quantum applications has only sparely been considered. Addressing either of these issues necessitates a careful study of the most energetically efficient implementation of elementary quantum operations.

arxiv-2202-12369.title: On Monocular Depth Estimation and Uncertainty Quantification using Classification Approaches for Regression
arxiv-2202-12369.creator: Xuanlong Yu, Gianni Franchi, Emanuel Aldea
arxiv-2202-12369.description: Abstract Monocular depth is important in many tasks, such as 3D reconstruction and autonomous driving. Deep learning based models achieve state-of-the-art performance in this field. A set of novel approaches for estimating monocular depth consists of transforming the regression task into a classification one.

arxiv-2306-14331.description: Abstract . In this paper, we present some basic properties concerning the quasi-derivation algebra Q ​ D ​ e ​ r ​ ( 𝒜 ) QDer(\mathcal{A}) and the quasi-centroid algebra Q ​ C ​ ( 𝒜 ) QC(\mathcal{A}) of associative algebra 𝒜 \mathcal{A} .

arxiv-2310-07796.title: Light quark mass dependence of nucleon electromagnetic form factors in dispersively modified chiral perturbation theory
arxiv-2310-07796.creator: Fernando Alvarado 1,2, Di An 2, Luis Alvarez-Ruso 1, Stefan Leupold 2
arxiv-2310-07796.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fernando Alvarado 1,2, Di An 2, Luis Alvarez-Ruso 1, Stefan Leupold 2. The nucleon isovector electromagnetic form factors are calculated up to next-to-next-to-leading order by combining relativistic chiral perturbation theory (ChPT) of pion, nucleon, and Δ ⁡ ( 1232 ) \Delta(1232) with dispersion theory. We specifically address the light-quark mass dependence of the form factors, achieving a good description of recent Lattice QCD results over a range of Q 2 ≲ 0.6 Q^{2}\lesssim 0.6 GeV 2 and M π ≲ 350 M_{\pi}\lesssim 350 MeV.

arxiv-2411-08005.title: Berry Curvature and Spin-One Color Superconductivity
arxiv-2411-08005.creator: Noriyuki Sogabe, Yi Yin
arxiv-2411-08005.description: Abstract We explore the interplay between Berry curvature and topological properties in single-flavor color superconductors, where quarks form spin-one Cooper pairs. By deriving a new relation, we connect the topological nodal structure of the gap function in momentum space to the (nonabelian) Berry flux associated with paired quarks. This generalizes the early work by Li and Haldane [Phys. Rev. Lett.

arxiv-2511-06745.title: Physically-Grounded Goal Imagination: Physics-Informed Variational Autoencoder for Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2511-06745.creator: Lan Thi Ha Nguyen, Kien Ton Manh, Anh Do Duc, Nam Pham Hai
arxiv-2511-06745.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lan Thi Ha Nguyen, Kien Ton Manh, Anh Do Duc, Nam Pham Hai. Self-supervised goal-conditioned reinforcement learning enables robots to autonomously acquire diverse skills without human supervision. However, a central challenge is the goal setting problem: robots must propose feasible and diverse goals that are achievable in their current environment.

arxiv-2602-23246.title: Enhanced Interband Optical Nonlinearities from Coupled Quantum Wells
arxiv-2602-23246.creator: Rithvik Ramesh, Madeline Brown, Amberly Ricks, Sedigheh Esfahani, Patrick Devaney, Kevin Wen, Moaz Waqar, Zarko Sakotic, Sander A. Mann, Teddy Hsieh, Alec M. Skipper, Qian Meng, Hyunseung Jung, MicheleCotrufo, Farbod Shafiei, Michael C. Downer, Sanjay Shakkottai, Mark Wistey, Igal Brener, Xiaoqing P
arxiv-2602-23246.description: Abstract The recent, rapid advances in nonlinear chipscale nanophotonics in the visible and near-infrared have been largely driven by manipulating the local dielectric environment proximate to decades-old workhorse bulk nonlinear optical materials, rather than increasing the inherent strength of their nonlinear response.

pmc-10638693.title: Thoracic endovascular aortic repair for hemolysis 17 years after insertion of classical elephant trunk: a case report
pmc-10638693.creator: Atsuyuki Mitsuishi, Nobuyuki Hirose, Unpei Okamoto, Tatsuya Noguchi, Juri Kawaguchi, Yujiro Miura
pmc-10638693.description: BackgroundThe classical elephant trunk (ET) technique is a very useful surgical procedure; however, haemolysis in the aorta associated with ET has been previously reported. It normally occurs within several years after the surgery, and it is a rare case of rapidly progressing haemolysis 10 or more years after aortic arch replacement with ET.

pmc-10683589.title: Longitudinal characterization of behavioral, morphological and transcriptomic changes in a tauopathy mouse model
pmc-10683589.creator: Qing Cao, Manasa Kumar, Allea Frazier, Jamal B. Williams, Shengkai Zhao, Zhen Yan
pmc-10683589.description: Neurodegenerative disorders, such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD), have the gradual onset of neurobiological changes preceding clinical diagnosis by decades. To elucidate how brain dysfunction proceeds in neurodegenerative disorders, we performed longitudinal characterization of behavioral, morphological, and transcriptomic changes in a tauopathy mouse model, P301S transgenic mice.

pmc-10735918.title: OVARIAN AGING: A TARGET FOR GEROPROTECTION IN WOMEN
pmc-10735918.creator: Yousin Suh
pmc-10735918.description: The ovary is the first organ to undergo early-onset aging in the human body, affecting both fertility and overall health in women. However, the biological mechanisms underlying human ovarian aging have been poorly understood. To understand the molecular, cellular, and genetic basis of ovarian aging in humans, we performed integrative single-nuclei multi-omics analyses of young and reproductively aged human ovaries.

pmc-10748374.title: IFITM1 and IFITM3 Proteins Inhibit the Infectivity of Progeny HIV-1 without Disrupting Envelope Glycoprotein Clusters
pmc-10748374.creator: Smita Verma, Yen-Cheng Chen, Mariana Marin, Scott E Gillespie, Gregory B Melikyan, Chen Liang
pmc-10748374.description: Human interferon-induced transmembrane (IFITM) proteins inhibit the fusion of a broad spectrum of enveloped viruses, both when expressed in target cells and when present in infected cells. Upon expression in infected cells, IFITMs incorporate into progeny virions and reduce their infectivity by a poorly understood mechanism.

pmc-11656025.title: Gonadal hormone abnormalities in young patients with first-episode schizophrenia
pmc-11656025.creator: Qiang Hu, Jindong Wang, Jing Liang, Meihong Xiu, Shuangli Zhang, Fengchun Wu
pmc-11656025.description: BackgroundGonadal hormones have been reported to be involved in the molecular mechanisms of schizophrenia (SCH). However, only a few studies have examined the gonadal hormone dysfunctions in first-episode schizophrenia (FES) patients, in particular in young patients with SCH. This study was designed to investigate the sex differences in gonadal hormones in young and antipsychotic-naïve FES patients.

pmc-11712004.title: Catheter Ablation for Ventricular Tachycardia in Patients With Biopsy-Proven Myocarditis
pmc-11712004.creator: Le Li, Ligang Ding, Shangyu Liu, Lingmin Wu, Lihui Zheng, Yulong Xiong, Zhuxin Zhang, Likun Zhou, Yan Yao
pmc-11712004.description: BackgroundCatheter ablation (CA) is increasingly recognized as an effective treatment for ventricular tachycardia (VT) in myocarditis patients, although current evidence is based on less robust data.ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to confirm CA's efficacy in reducing VT recurrence and to identify arrhythmic risk factors in biopsy-proven myocarditis patients.

pmc-12527979.title: FITM2‐Related Siddiqi Syndrome in Two Iranian Siblings
pmc-12527979.creator: Raha Ahmadi, Mohammad Javad Bavarsad, Meysam Feizollah Jani, Reza Azizimalamiri
pmc-12527979.description: We report the first two Iranian siblings with Siddiqi syndrome, carrying a novel likely pathogenic FITM2 variant. Both presented with hallmark features, including early‐onset sensorineural hearing loss, severe generalized dystonia, growth failure, and ichthyosis of the lower limbs, expanding the geographic and genetic spectrum of this rare disorder.
